requirements.name: build-service
requirements.text: Implement in Python 3.11 or newer with FastAPI, served by uvicorn, over SQLite. Tests run under pytest, using FastAPI's `TestClient` for the API. The product is an executable named `fxrates` at the application root.

requirements.name: scoring-harness
requirements.text:
`sources/run.sh` is the scoring entry point. It is supplied, not authored, and is staged verbatim
into the application root with the data files. `drydock uat` runs `sh sources/run.sh` from the
completed application root and takes its exit code and output as the score.

requirements.name: database-selection
requirements.text:
`DATABASE_URL` names the SQLite database file, optionally prefixed `sqlite://`. When it is unset,
`DATABASE_PATH` is used, then `data/app.db`.

requirements.name: persistence-layer
requirements.text:
All database access goes through the shipped
persistence library and the relational layer generated from `DATABASE.md`. Application code never
opens a database driver directly.

requirements.name: rates-table
requirements.text:
A rate is stored exactly as the ECB publishes it, as text. `0.943` stays `0.943`, never `0.9430`
and never a float.

requirements.name: init-command
requirements.text: | `fxrates init` | Drops the `rates` table if present and creates it empty. | Nothing. |

requirements.name: load-command
requirements.text: | `fxrates load <csv>` | Loads an ECB history file (rules below). | `dates,rates`, then the number of dates and of rates stored from the file. |

requirements.name: fetch-command
requirements.text: | `fxrates fetch` | Downloads `https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-hist.zip`, extracts `eurofxref-hist.csv`, and loads it as `load` does. | As `load`. |

requirements.name: serve-command
requirements.text: | `fxrates serve [--port <n>]` | Serves the HTTP API on `127.0.0.1:<n>` with uvicorn until stopped. Default port `8000`. | Nothing required. |

requirements.name: validate-history-file
requirements.text:
**A rejected file changes nothing.** The whole file is checked before the first write. A row
   with the wrong field count, an invalid or repeated date, or an invalid value rejects the file.

requirements.name: replace-existing-rates
requirements.text:
A rate for a (`date`, `currency`) that is already stored replaces it, so loading the same file
   twice leaves the database unchanged.

requirements.name: load-counts
requirements.text:
The reported `dates` counts the dates with at least one stored rate, and `rates` counts the
   rates stored.

requirements.name: failing-command-output
requirements.text: A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.

requirements.name: exit-codes
requirements.text:
**Exit codes.** `0` success. `1` operational failure: the file cannot be read, or a `fetch`
download fails. `2` usage error: unknown command, wrong argument count, `--port` not an integer.
`3` rejected file.

requirements.name: health-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /health` | `{"status": "ok"}` |

requirements.name: stats-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /stats` | `{"dates": <n>, "rates": <n>, "first": <date>, "last": <date>}`. `first` and `last` are `null` when the table is empty. |

requirements.name: currencies-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /currencies` | `{"base": "EUR", "currencies": [<code>, ...]}`: every currency with at least one stored rate, ascending. |

requirements.name: rates-by-date
requirements.text: | `GET /rates/{date}` | `{"date": <effective date>, "requested": <date>, "base": "EUR", "rates": {<code>: <rate>, ...}}`: every currency with a rate on the effective date. |

requirements.name: rates-latest
requirements.text: | `GET /rates/latest` | As `/rates/{date}` for the latest publication date, with `"requested": "latest"`. |

requirements.name: effective-date
requirements.text:
The ECB publishes on working days only. A request for date `D` uses the latest
publication date on or before `D`. If none exists, the response is `404`.

requirements.name: convert-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /convert?from=<code>&to=<code>&amount=<amount>[&date=<date>]` | `{"date": <effective date>, "from": <code>, "to": <code>, "amount": <amount>, "rate": <rate>, "result": <result>}`. Without `date`, the latest publication date is used. |

requirements.name: history-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /history/{code}[?start=<date>][&end=<date>]` | `{"currency": <code>, "base": "EUR", "count": <n>, "min": <rate>, "max": <rate>, "mean": <mean>, "points": [{"date": <date>, "rate": <rate>}, ...]}` for the publication dates from `start` through `end` inclusive, ascending. Both bounds are optional. With no points, `count` is `0`, `min`, `max`, and `mean` are `null`, and `points` is `[]`. |

requirements.name: value-formats
requirements.text:
- `<rate>` in `/rates`, `min`, `max`, and `points` is the stored text, as a JSON string.
- `/convert` `amount` matches `[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?` and is echoed as given, as a JSON string.
- `/convert` `rate` is `rate(to) / rate(from)`, computed exactly and rounded half to even to six
  decimal places, written with exactly six decimals, as a JSON string: `"161.770000"`.
- `/convert` `result` is `amount × rate(to) / rate(from)`, computed exactly from the stored rates
  (not from the rounded `rate`) and rounded half to even to two decimal places, written with
  exactly two decimals, as a JSON string: `"82.01"`.
- `/history` `min` and `max` are the stored text of the smallest and largest rate by value.
  `mean` is the exact mean rounded half to even to six decimal places, written with exactly six
  decimals, as a JSON string.

requirements.name: not-found-errors
requirements.text: | `404` | No publication on or before the requested date; a `/convert` currency other than EUR with no rate on the effective date; a `/history` currency with no stored rate at all (including `EUR`). |

requirements.name: validation-errors
requirements.text: | `422` | A malformed date in the path or query, a malformed `amount`, or a missing required query parameter. FastAPI's request validation produces this status. |

requirements.name: load-visible-to-server
requirements.text: A load that completes while the server is running is visible to the next request.

requirements.name: offline-test-script
requirements.text:
The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs its own pytest suite
from the application root and exits zero only when every test passes. The suite covers each
command, each load rule, each endpoint, the effective-date rule, rounding, and each error status,
against a real temporary database, with `fetch` stubbed.

requirements.name: init-database
requirements.text: check A1 0 init < /dev/null

requirements.name: load-csv-files
requirements.text:
check A2 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
22,176
EOF

requirements.name: load-idempotent-replace
requirements.text:
check A3 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
22,176
EOF

requirements.name: load-reject-invalid-file
requirements.text: check A4 3 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv" < /dev/null

requirements.name: load-unreadable-file
requirements.text: check A5 1 load "$WORK/no-such-file.csv" < /dev/null

requirements.name: usage-errors
requirements.text:
check U1 2 < /dev/null
check U2 2 frobnicate < /dev/null
check U3 2 load < /dev/null
check U4 2 serve --port notaport < /dev/null

requirements.name: serve-health
currencies-endpoint
rates-by-date
requirements.text:
http H4 200 '/rates/2025-01-17' <<'EOF'
http H5 200 '/rates/2025-01-18' <<'EOF'
http H6 404 '/rates/2024-12-31' < /dev/null
http H7 422 '/rates/2025-13-01' < /dev/null

requirements.name: rates-latest
requirements.text: http H8 200 '/rates/latest' <<'EOF'

requirements.name: convert-endpoint
requirements.text:
http H9 200 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP&amount=100&date=2025-01-17' <<'EOF'
http H10 200 '/convert?from=EUR&to=JPY&amount=250.25&date=2025-01-05' <<'EOF'
http H11 200 '/convert?from=GBP&to=EUR&amount=1000' <<'EOF'
http H12 200 '/convert?from=SEK&to=CNY&amount=12345.67&date=2025-01-20' <<'EOF'

requirements.name: convert-errors
requirements.text:
http H13 404 '/convert?from=USD&to=XXX&amount=1' < /dev/null
http H14 422 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP' < /dev/null
http H15 422 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP&amount=abc' < /dev/null
http H16 404 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP&amount=10&date=2024-12-01' < /dev/null

requirements.name: history-points-summary
requirements.text:
http H17 200 '/history/USD?start=2025-01-20&end=2025-01-24' <<'EOF'
http H18 200 '/history/CHF?start=2025-01-27' <<'EOF'
http H20 200 '/history/USD?start=2025-02-01' <<'EOF'

requirements.name: history-errors
requirements.text:
http H19 404 '/history/HRK' < /dev/null
http H21 422 '/history/GBP?start=2025-01-31-x' < /dev/null

requirements.name: load-visible-to-running-server
requirements.text:
# ── L. A load while the server runs is visible to the next request ───────────────────────
check L1 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
2,16
EOF
http L2 200 '/stats' <<'EOF'
http L3 200 '/rates/latest' <<'EOF'
http L4 200 '/rates/2025-02-01' <<'EOF'
http L5 200 '/history/AUD?start=2025-01-30' <<'EOF'

requirements.name: grader-passes
requirements.text: # run.sh — FxRates grader. Do not filter, skip, or reinterpret.
